relations.text: Tenet傘下の収益管理会社Conifer Health Solutionsの23.8%を保有
relations.text_en: Owns 23.8% of Tenet's Conifer Health Solutions

source.label: Tenet Healthcare 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: At December 31, 2025, we owned 76.2% of Conifer Health Solutions, and CommonSpirit Health held a 23.8% ownership position.

companies.name: ジョン・ミューア・ヘルス
companies.sub: 非営利の病院グループ

relations.text: サンフランシスコ湾岸地域で病院の合弁を組む(Tenet 51%、John Muir 49%)
relations.text_en: Joint venture partner in a San Francisco Bay Area hospital (Tenet 51%, John Muir 49%)

source.label: Tenet Healthcare 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: (5) Owned by a limited liability company formed as part of a joint venture with John Muir Health, a not‐for‐profit health system in the San Francisco Bay area; a Tenet subsidiary owned a 51% interest in the entity at December 31, 2025, and John Muir Health owned a 49% interest.

relations.text: Tenet傘下のUSPIと外来手術センターの合弁(Lonestar Endoscopy)を組む
relations.text_en: Runs an ambulatory surgery center joint venture (Lonestar Endoscopy) with Tenet's USPI

source.label: Sila Realty Trust の発表(8-K添付)
source.quote: The ASC is leased to Lonestar Endoscopy, a joint venture between Baylor Scott & White Health (Moody's: Aa2), the largest not-for-profit healthcare system in Texas, and USPI, a subsidiary of Tenet Healthcare Corporation

source.quote: Several large national companies own and/or manage surgical facilities, in some cases in connection with other lines of business with which we do not compete, including HCA Healthcare, Inc., AMSURG Corp., Tenet Healthcare Corporation and Optum, Inc.
